knownIssuesOrDesignQuestions: The World Map overlay currently overlaps the lower-left playable board area in compact browser widths. This is acceptable for the trial but should be redesigned if kept.
The main board viewport still uses the existing board viewport dimensions; the map marker reflects that region. A later pass could make the main playable viewport a strict square crop.

The minimap redraws the field footprint when field bounds/count/size changes, not on every tile trait/tier change. That keeps it cheap but means tiny minimap colors are more footprint/overview than exact live state.
recommendedNextSteps: Have the user try the trial and decide whether the map belongs bottom-left, beside the board, collapsible, or integrated into the right rail.
If the feel is good, add an intentional square main viewport mode for large fields and make the minimap marker square by design.
If shipping soon, stage only intended gameplay, Weather Jar, docs/phaser3-performance-tips.md if desired, and handoff files; leave unrelated dirty docs/media alone.
doNotRevert: Do not remove the regrowth frame budget from the earlier optimization pass unless replacing it with another burst-smoothing mechanism.
Do not revert the earlier Weather Jar sooner tuning unless the user asks.
Do not treat the minimap placement as final UX; it is a live trial surface for the larger-world direction.
finalUserIntent: Let the user play with the rectangular stress field plus World Map overlay, then decide whether to formalize large-field map navigation and square viewport mode.
